objective: find larger terminal-score gains by executing complete multi-action shield/cut prefixes before the confirmed bounded P9 fallback
primary_comparator: current qualified bounded P9 conservative policy
metric: paired final score; higher is better
analysis_unit: one graph-family/repetition seed paired across all arms

development.status: previously used development data; exploratory only

candidate_search.root_domain: every legal shield and cut; no persona, sign, direction, positive-graph, or singleton-ROI prefilter
candidate_search.objective: exact terminal component score after the structural prefix and a bounded mean-response persuasion allocation
candidate_search.beam: retain distinct terminal topologies by complete terminal objective at every depth; stopping at any depth is allowed
candidate_search.refinement: one deterministic delete-or-exchange neighborhood pass around the best beam plan
candidate_search.execution: if the plan passes paired selection and audit scenarios, execute the entire still-legal structural prefix, then return control to bounded P9 conservative

risk_gate.selection: mean positive and minimum nonnegative over scenarios 0-4 against the same public-greedy first-action continuation
risk_gate.audit: mean positive and minimum nonnegative over unused scenarios 5-12
risk_gate.interpretation: development decision screen, not a confidence interval or official-score prediction

reported_diagnostics: searched root actions and expanded topology states
selected structural prefix and planned persuasion allocation
executed action counts and remaining budget
first intervention divergence versus bounded P9
predicted selection/audit deltas and realized paired delta
development_decision: complete all six paired seeds for both variants
retain a variant only if mean gain over bounded P9 is positive
prefer beam4 unless beam6 improves mean by at least 0.5 points
do not promote, package, or open new confirmation from this exploratory cohort
constraints: all predictions remain in copied PredictiveState values
do not modify P9/P8 frozen policy, runtime, qualification, config, or submission build
no hidden response factors in policy inputs or reports
no conversion of local score to official score
